data.summary: The pod startup exceeded the 10.0-second SLO, taking 61.0 seconds to become Ready. The primary delay was due to model loading, specifically the download of a 524 MB model, which took 53.369 seconds. This activity alone accounted for 87.5% of the total startup time.

findings.statement: The pod took 61.0 seconds to become Ready, exceeding the 10.0-second SLO.
Within 'app_init', the 'model.download' span took 53.369 seconds to download 524288000 bytes (524 MB) from 'http://model-hub.kubesage-infra.svc.cluster.local/weights-500m.bin'.
The combined model download and load time was 53.831 seconds.

ruled_out.reason: The image pull took 4.184 seconds for 53328919 bytes, which is a small fraction of the total startup time and indicates a reasonable pull throughput of 12745918 bytes/s.
The image pull throughput was 12745918 bytes/s, which does not indicate a slow registry.
The scheduling phase took only 1.0 second and there were no failed scheduling events.
The readiness probe took 0.647 seconds, which is a minor part of the total startup time.
